name: bluesky-mcp
description: Bluesky (social): me, publish_text, read_comments, read_mentions, analytics_post. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_bluesky_identifier.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER
platform_mcp_bluesky_identifier.description: Bluesky handle (e.g. alice.bsky.social) or the account's e-mail; sent as `identifier` to com.atproto.server.createSession.

platform_mcp_bluesky_password.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BLUESKY_PASSWORD
platform_mcp_bluesky_password.description: An app password from Settings → Privacy and security → App Passwords, never the account password; the runtime exchanges it for a short-lived accessJwt (createSession is capped at 300/day per IP, so the token is cached and re-issued only on expiry or 401).

platform_mcp_bluesky_did.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BLUESKY_DID
platform_mcp_bluesky_did.description: The account's DID (did:plc:..., shown in Settings → Account or returned by com.atproto.server.getSession); used as `repo` when writing records. The createRecord lexicon also accepts the handle here.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /xrpc/com.atproto.server.getSession (auth required) returns {handle, did, email?, emailConfirmed?, active?, status?} for the session's account. docs.bsky.app/docs/api/* now 301s to https://endpoints.bsky.app/; the lexicon JSON in the atproto repo is the authoritative definition.

tools.name: publish_text
tools.description: POST /xrpc/com.atproto.repo.createRecord {repo, collection: app.bsky.feed.post, record: {$type, text (<= 300 graphemes), createdAt}} returns {uri, cid}; the AT-URI is the post id used by read_comments / analytics_post (app.bsky.feed.post requires text and createdAt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluesky-social/atproto/main/lexicons/app/bsky/feed/post.json; the runtime fills createdAt with the current UTC time). `reply_to` is ignored: a reply needs reply.root and reply.parent as {uri, cid} strong refs, and the parent's cid would have to be looked up first. No url / created_at in the response.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: GET /xrpc/app.bsky.feed.getPostThread?uri=<at-uri> (depth default 6, parentHeight default 80 kept) returns {thread: threadViewPost {post, parent?, replies?}}; `comments` are the direct replies (each a threadViewPost whose `post` is a postView {uri, cid, author{did, handle}, record, indexedAt, ...}, deeper replies stay under raw.replies). page/limit are not sent: the thread comes back in one response. A reply that is a notFoundPost / blockedPost has no `post` and maps to an empty row.

tools.name: read_mentions
tools.description: GET /xrpc/app.bsky.notification.listNotifications?reasons=mention&limit=N (limit 1..100, default 50) returns {cursor, notifications[{uri, cid, author{did, handle}, reason, reasonSubject, record, isRead, indexedAt}]}; `reasons` is an array parameter sent as one value (mention), so replies / quotes are excluded. Pagination is cursor-based, so `page` and `since` are not sent.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: GET /xrpc/app.bsky.feed.getPosts?uris=<at-uri> (array parameter, up to 25; one value is sent) returns {posts[postView {uri, cid, author, record, replyCount, repostCount, likeCount, quoteCount, indexedAt}]}; counts are mapped from posts[0]. The runtime cannot compose a nested `metrics` object, so counts are top-level fields (postView: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluesky-social/atproto/main/lexicons/app/bsky/feed/defs.json).
